rationale: The portfolio makes a specific, credible connection between professional operating work and the conditions under which people can enter, influence, remember, and continue a shared system. About names the artistic, civic, technical, and social connection without displacing the technical project manager role. WOW List, Sunday Dinner/196, and NYC Artist Coalition provide three distinct dated continuities: community vocabulary becomes publishing infrastructure, hospitality becomes participant-sensitive handoffs, and shared civic inquiry becomes public action paths and recoverable records. Images and workflow specimens give this account bodily and practical substance. Shared credit, private participant boundaries, and the limits of historical and current work remain explicit.
